description:
Create an interactive GeoGebra applet that demonstrates the Fourier series convergence to a square wave. 

1. Define a square wave function f(x) with period 2π and amplitude 1 (e.g., using `sgn(sin(x))` or `If(sin(x)>=0, 1, -1)`).
2. Create an integer slider `n` ranging from 1 to 20.
3. Define the Fourier partial sum function g(x) using the Sum command. The formula for the square wave approximation is: `(4/π) * Sum(sin((2k-1)x)/(2k-1), k, 1, n)`.
4. Style the functions so they are distinct (different colors/styles).
5. Add a text annotation to the view (e.g., displaying the value of n).

Save the project as `fourier_square_wave.ggb` in `~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/`.
